# pvecli storage list

List all storage.

```text
pvecli storage list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-n`, `--node VALUE` | Show storage for specific node. |
| `-o`, `--order VALUE` | Sort by column (moved to first position), e.g. storage, type, usage. |
| `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |
